name: Bedrock Longpole
description: Open a pike bout with a straight jab, the way the court teaches paired students to begin.

name: Statute Footspike
description: Hold the pike levelled before the body so a pressing foe cannot close the distance.

name: Pikegrace
description: Step in beside a partner so both pikes face the same foe from two angles.

name: Pikegift
description: Warm the shaft with qi in the court's slow count so the grip and the thrust stay true.

name: Millstone Pikeshaft
description: Lay the shaft over a foe's weapon and bind it with a pulse of qi.

name: Mastdecree
description: Pass a thrust along the court's two ranks so each point follows the last into the foe.

name: Vacuum Pikebands
description: Drive a heavy qi-backed thrust of the kind taught in the court's drill hall, piercing mail.

name: Inviolate Mastlength
description: Lock the court's square guard with qi so its crossed points hold against a heavy rush.

name: Steelshaft
description: Plunge two crossed thrusts onto one point in a field-qi stroke that only the court's masters teach.

name: Quenched Steelcap
description: The court's school finish: two crossed pike strokes, high then low, closing on a single killing point.

name: Parityshaft
description: Take the pose that balances point and ferrule so either end is ready to strike.

name: Steelbrace
description: Jab from a low basin stance, the point rising along the edge of the foe's guard.

name: Parity Pikeshoe
description: Turn the shaft so whichever end meets the blow turns it aside along the wood.

name: Windborne Couchout
description: Walk in a low pivoting arc, the butt dragging so the gathered qi stays settled.

name: Interstice Pikehead
description: Settle breath and qi into the lower belly and feel the foe's weight through the shaft.

name: Haemalpike
description: Let the point's rebound swing the iron butt round on a thread of qi into a foe's ribs.

name: Tyrannous Press
description: Seize an enemy weapon between point and ferrule laid in a vee, held by qi.

name: Levelhold Pledge
description: Push a crowding foe back with the shaft held crosswise like a rim, qi spreading the shove.

name: Ashstaff Banner
description: Rush forward from the basin stance and thrust with the point, the ferrule following as a second blow.

name: Steadfast Steelcap
description: Plant the ferrule and let gathered qi hold the brace steady against the heaviest charge.

name: Sweeping Bristle
description: Sweep point then ferrule in matched arcs of field qi, clearing the whole front of the stance.

name: Vaunted Quenched Present
description: The school's finish: pour all the gathered basin of qi through the ferrule end into one thrust.

name: Solar Pikecollar
description: Crouch as the school's first lesson teaches, gathering strength in the legs before the stoop.

name: Squall Present
description: Jab down the stoop's slanting line so the point lands on the foe's shoulder.

name: Squallpike
description: Spread the hands wide like talons and catch a cut on the middle of the shaft.

name: Pealpike
description: Mark one foe in a crowd with the school's sharp qi sense and follow every shift he makes.

name: Pulsarbrace
description: Fall into the thrust with qi gathered at the point, as the school's stoop teaches.

name: Unbending Footspike
description: Press the shaft down on a foe's weapon and hold the quarry pinned with qi.

name: Wheeling Brace
description: Retreat in a wheeling circle, the pike levelled, ready to stoop again at the first opening.

name: Vacuum Mastlength
description: Fall onto the foe with the full body behind a qi-loaded point, as the school's masters do.

name: Steelpike
description: Pause in a braced hover on qi, absorbing a rush before the next stoop.

name: Spectral Brace
description: Vanish upward on field qi and dive back onto the foe from beyond his sight.

name: Quenched Bristle
description: The school's finishing stoop: a long falling thrust that the whole school learns as its mark.

name: Inferno Pikeshoe
description: Jab along the line of the file, one stroke in the flow of two parallel ranks.

name: Peal Pikeshaft
description: Cross the shaft over a neighbour's on the river side to turn a cut flowing in.

name: Pikebands Odyssey
description: Advance in parallel with the next file so both flow forward at the same pace.

name: Couchout Decree
description: Send two currents of qi down the shaft so they meet in the point as it lands.

name: Venom Ashstaff
description: Drag a foe's weapon low along the ground like a stone dragged on a riverbed.

name: Prismshaft
description: Lock the shaft into the brace with qi that flows like a river held between its banks.

name: Vacuumbrace
description: Close two files on one foe and drive a qi-loaded thrust from each into the same place.

name: Pikehead Troth
description: Press the whole line forward in a swelling spate that drives foes back off their feet.

name: Demolition Pikebands
description: Sweep two files' pikes through an arc together, field qi breaking every foe along the front.

name: Intrepid Solar Longpole
description: The school's finish: both files close at once, their points flooding into the broken front.

name: Bedrock Footspike
description: Open in the school's hold, one hand driving, the other bracing, the shaft level between.

name: Squallpress
description: Jab with the left hand driving and the right hand steadying the shaft.

name: Squall Pikeshaft
description: Slide the right hand's grip to guard across the body and turn a cut aside.

name: Weaving Pikehead
description: Weave two steps, one on each track, so the pike's point barely moves between them.

name: Thunderclap Brace
description: Pulse one qi track after the other down the shaft so the thrust lands twice.

name: Thrall Pikecollar
description: Cross the two tracks over a foe's weapon and bind it to the shaft with qi.

name: Despotic Mastlength
description: Feint with one track then strike on the other, so the foe guards the wrong side.

name: Pikeseal
description: Parry on one track and let the rebound swing the shaft onto the other for a quick return.

name: Triumphant Pikecollar
description: Drive both tracks of qi into one heavy thrust that breaks through shield and plate together.

name: Prism Longpole
description: Lock both tracks into the brace so the square holds against a crowd's whole weight.

name: Pikebanner
description: Merge both tracks of field qi in the shaft and break a rank with one stroke.

name: Present Verdict
description: The school's finish: drive left and right tracks in turn, the second thrust riding the first.

name: Piketroth
description: Stand with the pike levelled at a high place, the sky open behind the shoulders.

name: Bracetriumph
description: Jab with two threads of qi, one at the point and one at the grip, running in step.

name: Deluge Ashstaff
description: Step up onto higher footing while the pike stays levelled, gaining a point above the foe.

name: Radiance Levelhold
description: Drive the first current of core qi down the shaft into the point in a single thrust.

name: Shaftpledge
description: Send the second current along the shaft to bind a foe's weapon where it touches.

name: Peal Pikecollar
description: Spread core qi in the open air at the summit to sense the foes around the height.

name: Phantasm Steelcap
description: Cross both currents in the guard so a blow's force is turned back along the second.

name: Radiance Pikeshoe
description: Thrust with both currents of core qi merging at the head, piercing a raised shield.

name: Sacrosanct Pikeshaft
description: Hold the brace on two currents of core qi so a charge finds no give.

name: Inferno Levelhold
description: Cleave the whole front in a wide arc, core qi lengthening the stroke past the point.

name: Royal Pulsar Press
description: The school's finish: both currents of core qi drawn into one long spearing thrust from the height.

name: Prism Steelcap
description: Stand with the pike levelled and the oath unspoken but held, as the course's first page requires.

name: Vigorshaft
description: Open with a jab thrown into the wind, the point steadied by the sworn line.

name: Advancing Press
description: Advance one footing at a time along the oath's line without breaking the pike's level.

name: Quenched Pikebands
description: Feed qi into the thrust on the strength of the oath so it bites through armour.

name: Pressvow
description: Lay the shaft across a foe's weapon and bind it as the wind binds a flag.

name: Prism Ashstaff
description: Take a blow on the oath-held guard and return its force along the shaft.

name: Pealshaft
description: Read the wind with a thread of qi to take a bearing on every foe in reach.

name: Prism Present
description: Thrust with the full oath and qi, driving the point through plate where the course teaches.

name: Enshrined Footspike
description: Hold the brace by oath and wind, giving no ground to a heavy press.

name: Imperial Press
description: Loose the oath's whole weight in a gale of field qi that breaks the front rank.

name: Fearless Quenched Levelhold
description: The course's finish: the sworn thrust driven home with wind and qi, the last lesson of the oath.

name: Stately Mastlength
description: Hold the levelled pike on the bearing taken, the way the school drills it on the plateau.

name: Haemalshaft
description: Jab short along the bearing line, keeping the rest of the shaft quiet.

name: Dunemast
description: Shift the pace across level ground to the next bearing without lowering the point.

name: Mastverdict
description: Feed qi along the held bearing and drive the point in at its end.

name: Sigilbrace
description: Pin a foe's weapon to the ground with the shaft, held by qi on the bearing line.

name: Radiance Pikehead
description: Take the blow on the shaft without moving off the bearing and send its force back.

name: Vacuum Pikeshoe
description: Thrust with field qi along the bearing, the point arriving straight and hard through shield.

name: Pikeshoe Covenant
description: Brace on the bearing line so the shock of a charge runs through the shaft into the ground.

name: Magmamast
description: Sweep along the whole bearing line with field qi, striking every foe standing on it.

name: Magnificent Ashstaff
description: The school's finish: lock the bearing on the foe and drive one thrust down it that cannot be turned.

name: Steel Pikehead
description: Hold the levelled pike at the plateau's lip, where the school teaches no step back is possible.

name: Shafttriumph
description: Jab along the plateau's edge line at a foe climbing the slope.

name: Immaculate Longpole
description: Parry with a short shaft turn that spills the blow over the edge.

name: Delugepress
description: Slide sideways along the edge on the balls of the feet, the point still levelled.

name: Steel Mastlength
description: Thrust with qi on the oath never to yield the edge, the point biting deep.

name: Tyrannous Bristle
description: Bind a climbing foe's weapon against the edge's rim with the shaft and qi.

name: Interstice Pikebands
description: Read the updraft along the shaft to know who is climbing and how fast.

name: Eclipse Steelcap
description: Receive a blow on the braced shaft and send its force back down the slope.

name: Vacuum Couchout
description: Thrust from the edge with field qi, driving a climbing foe back down the slope.

name: Longpole Pledge
description: Brace at the lip by oath, the shaft taking a charge that has no room to turn.

name: Footspike Edict
description: Sweep a great arc along the lip with field qi, breaking everything that has climbed up.

name: Steel Bristle
description: The school's finish: a thrust delivered with no step back, the whole line's oath behind the point.

name: Enshrined Pikecollar
description: Stand in the oath line with the pike levelled beside the next pike on open ground.

name: Masttriumph
description: Jab on the command of the line, the point meeting the foe at the same moment as the others.

name: Brace Solace
description: Step together with the line so no gap opens as it moves across open ground.

name: Sovereign Bristle
description: Send qi along the shaft in time with the line, so every point strikes as one.

name: Volition Couchout
description: Hold a foe's weapon down with the line's shafts crossed and a steady thread of qi.

name: Radiance Ashstaff
description: Let the line take the shock together and return it as one pulse along the shafts.

name: Serene Steelcap
description: Feel through the neighbouring shafts where the line is thin and which side leans.

name: Present Crown
description: Thrust with field qi in unison with the line, the points striking as one blow.

name: Shared Pikecollar
description: Brace the whole line with shared qi so it holds on open ground without walls.

name: Cleaving Levelhold
description: Sweep the line's pikes together in a gale of field qi that clears the field before it.

name: Imperious Present Seal
description: The school's finish: the whole line presses forward as one, the sworn points driving the field before them.

name: Steelmast
description: Hold the pike levelled into the wind at full reach, as the doctrine begins.

name: Bedrock Pikebands
description: Jab at full stretch with the wind on the back, the point extending beyond the foe's reach.

name: Pikeshaft Grace
description: Slide the rear foot after a lunge so the long reach is regained without breaking line.

name: Radiance Couchout
description: Feed field qi into the full-reach thrust so the point arrives hard at the end of its line.

name: Gloom Brace
description: Press a foe's weapon down at the shaft's far end while staying beyond his own reach.

name: Interstice Footspike
description: Send qi along the full length of the shaft to feel foes just beyond its point.

name: Prismmast
description: Thrust at extreme reach with the wind and field qi, striking before the foe can close.

name: Consecrated Pikeshaft
description: Brace the pike at full reach so a rush must meet the point before the man.

name: Seasonpress
description: Cross the whole reach in a flash of field qi and break the foe's guard from beyond it.

name: Dauntless Pulsar Couchout
description: The doctrine's finish: qi poured down the whole shaft in one drive that carries the full reach.

name: Statute Longpole
description: Stand levelled with core qi settled, the oath held in the stance before any thrust.

name: Thunderclap Pikehead
description: Jab on a sworn line, the point arriving with the force of a rising gale.

name: Pall Steelcap
description: Guard with the shaft held steady from the core, letting blows slide off.

name: Deluge Mastlength
description: Surge forward in a single sworn step on a gust of core qi, the point steady.

name: Imperial Levelhold
description: Send core qi up the shaft as a gale and drive it out of the point in one stroke.

name: Binding Brace
description: Bind a foe's weapon with the shaft and a gale of sworn core qi.

name: Magnanimous Pikebands
description: Feel with core qi along the shaft for the bearing of every foe in the open.

name: Devout Mastlength
description: Take a blow in the held guard and return its force as a gale pulse along the shaft.

name: Dauntless Pikecollar
description: Drive a sworn thrust with core qi and the gale behind it, piercing shield and plate.

name: Immovable Pikeshaft
description: Brace on core qi and oath so a charge on open ground cannot move the pike.

name: Tempestuous Press
description: Loose the held core qi in a sweeping gale stroke that breaks the front of a charge.

name: Lordly Bristle
description: The canon's finish: core qi, oath and gale drawn into one thrust that the school hands down whole.
